description_en: Modifies the name, description, and capture window duration of a flow log
description_zh: 编辑流日志的名称、描述以及捕获窗口时长
kebab_example: aliyun cbn modify-flow-log-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --flow-log-id flowlog-m5evbtbpt0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyFlowLogAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the flow log.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
流日志的新名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: flow_log_name

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the flow log.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
流日志新的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the flow log.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
流日志所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The capture window duration for the flow log. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 60 or 600. Default value: 600
parameters.help_zh: 流日志捕获流量的捕获窗口时长。单位：秒。取值：60或600。默认值：600
parameters.name: interval

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.

true: successful.

false: failed
Success.description_zh:
当前接口调用是否成功。

true：成功。

false：失败
